_about: The travel journal (kb: decisions/controls "Travel journal"): the whole set at rest (entry 1 after the 2 s dwell), the place elephants (a jump: entry 2), N (seek minibrot: a flight, entry 3), then back (⌘Z) to the place, back to the whole set, forward (⇧⌘Z) to the place again. `fly` prints each journal change and the entries at the end; the final view is the place's.
